title.zh: 卷九十一 志第四十一上: 百官七
title.raw: 卷九十一 志第四十一上: 百官七 Volume 91 Treatises 44: Official Posts 7

translations.literal: Official Posts 7
translations.idiomatic: Official Posts 7

sentences.zh: 行中書省，凡十一，秩從一品，掌國庶務，統郡縣，鎮邊鄙，與都省為表裏。

translations.literal: The Branch Secretariats numbered eleven in all; their rank was senior first rank; they managed the state's miscellaneous affairs, oversaw prefectures and counties, guarded the border regions, and complemented the Metropolitan Secretariat as inner and outer.
translations.idiomatic: There were eleven branch secretariats in all, ranked at senior first rank. They handled general state business, supervised prefectures and counties, secured the frontiers, and worked in tandem with the metropolitan secretariat at the center.

sentences.zh: 國初，有征伐之役，分任軍民之事，皆稱行省，未有定制。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, when there were campaigns of conquest, those who divided responsibility for military and civil affairs were all called "Branch Secretariat"; there was as yet no fixed regulation.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's early years, whenever campaigns were undertaken, those charged with both military and civilian affairs were called "branch secretariats," but no fixed institution had yet been established.

sentences.zh: 中統、至元間，始分立行中書省，因事設官，官不必備，皆以省官出領其事。

translations.literal: Between the Zhongtong and Zhiyuan reign-periods, Branch Secretariats were first established separately; offices were set up according to events; posts need not be fully staffed; all used Secretariat officials sent out to lead the affairs.
translations.idiomatic: During the Zhongtong and Zhiyuan eras, separate branch secretariats were first instituted. Offices were created as needs arose, posts were not necessarily filled in full, and secretariat officials were dispatched to head each assignment.

sentences.zh: 其丞相，皆以宰執行某處省事系銜。

translations.literal: Their Chancellors all bore the concurrent title of a Councillor of State serving as Branch Secretariat Commissioner for such-and-such a place.
translations.idiomatic: Each chancellor bore a concurrent title as councillor of state serving concurrently as commissioner for a given region's branch secretariat affairs.

sentences.zh: 其後嫌於外重，改為某處行中書省。

translations.literal: Afterwards, lest they seem too powerful on the periphery, the name was changed to "Such-and-such Place Branch Secretariat."
translations.idiomatic: Later, because such titles seemed to grant too much regional weight, the designation was changed to a regional branch secretariat title.

sentences.zh: 凡錢糧、兵甲、屯種、漕運、軍國重事，無不領之。

translations.literal: All grain and funds, armor and arms, garrison farming, canal transport, and weighty matters of state and army—none were not under their charge.
translations.idiomatic: Revenue, armaments, garrison agriculture, canal transport, and every other major civil and military concern fell under their authority.

sentences.zh: 至元二十四年，改行尚書省，尋復如舊。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan it was changed to Branch Department of State Affairs; soon it reverted to the former arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 24 (1287) the name was changed to Branch Department of State Affairs, but the former title was soon restored.

sentences.zh: 至大二年，又改行尚書省，二年復如舊。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhida it was again changed to Branch Department of State Affairs; two years later it reverted to the former arrangement.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 2 (1309) the name was again changed to Branch Department of State Affairs, and two years later reverted once more.

translations.literal: Each province had one Chancellor, senior first rank;
translations.idiomatic: Each branch secretariat had one chancellor, of senior first rank;

translations.literal: two Pingzhang, senior first rank;
translations.idiomatic: two pingzhang, of senior first rank;

sentences.zh: 右丞一員，左丞一員，正二品；

translations.literal: one Right Vice Director and one Left Vice Director, regular second rank;
translations.idiomatic: one right and one left vice director, of regular second rank;

sentences.zh: 參知政事二員，從二品，甘肅、嶺北二省各減一員；

translations.literal: two Associate Administrators, junior second rank—the Gansu and Lingbei provinces each had one post reduced;
translations.idiomatic: two associate administrators, of junior second rank, with one post fewer each in Gansu and Lingbei;

translations.literal: two Directors, junior fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two directors, of junior fifth rank;

translations.literal: two Vice Directors, junior sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two vice directors, of junior sixth rank;

translations.literal: two Secretariat Clerks, junior seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: two secretariat clerks, of junior seventh rank;

sentences.zh: 掾史、蒙古必阇赤、回回令史、通事、知印、宣使，各省設員有差。

translations.literal: Secretarial clerks, Mongol bitxechi, Muslim clerks, interpreters, seal keepers, and envoys—the number of posts established in each province differed.
translations.idiomatic: Secretarial clerks, Mongol bitxechi, Muslim clerks, interpreters, seal keepers, and envoys were allotted in varying numbers from province to province.

sentences.zh: 舊制參政之下，有僉省、有同僉之屬，後罷不置。

translations.literal: Under the old system, below the Associate Administrators there were Branch Secretariat Commissioners and their subordinates of the same rank; later these were abolished and not reinstated.
translations.idiomatic: Formerly, beneath the associate administrators there had also been branch commissioners and their deputies; these posts were later abolished and not restored.

sentences.zh: 丞相或置或不置，尤慎於擇人，故往往缺焉。

translations.literal: The Chancellor might be appointed or not; selection of personnel was especially cautious, and therefore the post was often left vacant.
translations.idiomatic: A chancellor might or might not be appointed; because candidates were chosen with exceptional care, the post was often left unfilled.

sentences.zh: 河南江北等處行中書省。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Henan, Jiangbei, and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Henan, Jiangbei, and Other Regions

sentences.zh: 至元五年，罷隨路奧魯官，詔參政阿裏僉行省事，於河南等路立省。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhiyuan the circuit-level auru officials were abolished; an edict ordered Associate Administrator Ali to serve concurrently as Branch Secretariat Commissioner; a province was established in the Henan and other circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 5 (1268) the circuit-level auru offices were abolished, and Associate Administrator Ali was ordered to head branch secretariat affairs and establish a secretariat in Henan and neighboring circuits.

sentences.zh: 二十八年，以河南、江北系要沖之地，又新入版圖，宜於汴梁立省以控治之，遂署其地，統有河南十二路、七府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-eighth year, because Henan and Jiangbei were strategic places and had newly entered the map, it was fitting to establish a province at Bianliang to control and govern them; the seat was then fixed there, governing twelve circuits and seven prefectures of Henan.
translations.idiomatic: In year 28, because Henan and Jiangbei were vital corridors newly brought under rule, a secretariat was established at Bianliang to govern the region. It administered twelve circuits and seven prefectures of Henan.

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Jiangzhe and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Jiangzhe and Other Regions

sentences.zh: 至元十三年，初置江淮行省，治揚州。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Zhiyuan the Jianghuai Branch Secretariat was first established, with its seat at Yangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 13 (1276) the Jianghuai branch secretariat was first established, with its seat at Yangzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十一年，以地理民事非便，遷於杭州。

translations.literal: In the twenty-first year, because geography and civil affairs were inconvenient, it was moved to Hangzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 21 the seat was moved to Hangzhou, as the location was ill suited to civil administration.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，割江北諸郡隸河南，改曰江浙行省，統有三十路、一府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the northern Jiangbei prefectures were detached and placed under Henan; the name was changed to Jiangzhe Branch Secretariat, governing thirty circuits and one prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 the Jiangbei prefectures north of the river were transferred to Henan, and the secretariat was renamed Jiangzhe, administering thirty circuits and one prefecture.

sentences.zh: 江西等處行中書省，至元十四年置。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Jiangxi and Other Regions, established in the fourteenth year of Zhiyuan.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Jiangxi and Other Regions, established in Zhiyuan 14 (1277).

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year it was merged into the Fujian Branch Secretariat.
translations.idiomatic: In year 15 it was merged into the Fujian branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十七年，仍置省於龍興府，而福建自為行省，治泉州。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year the province was again established at Longxing Prefecture, while Fujian became its own branch secretariat, with its seat at Quanzhou.
translations.idiomatic: In year 17 the secretariat was restored at Longxing, while Fujian became a separate branch secretariat seated at Quanzhou.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，以福建行省並入江西。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the Fujian Branch Secretariat was merged into Jiangxi.
translations.idiomatic: In year 22 the Fujian branch secretariat was merged back into Jiangxi.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，又以福建省並入江浙。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year Fujian Province was again merged into Jiangzhe.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 Fujian was in turn merged into Jiangzhe.

translations.literal: This province governed eighteen circuits in all.
translations.idiomatic: This secretariat ultimately administered eighteen circuits.

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Huguang and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Huguang and Other Regions

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，右丞相伯顏伐宋，行中書省事於襄陽，尋以別將分省鄂州，為荊湖等路行中書省。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan the Right Chancellor Bayan campaigned against Song and exercised Branch Secretariat affairs at Xiangyang; soon a separate commander established a branch province at Ezhou, forming the Branch Secretariat for Jinghu and Other Circuits.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 11 (1274) Right Chancellor Bayan campaigned against Song and directed branch secretariat affairs from Xiangyang; a subordinate general soon set up a branch secretariat at Ezhou, forming the Jinghu branch secretariat.

sentences.zh: 十三年，取潭州，即署省治之。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year Tanzhou was taken and the provincial seat was immediately established there.
translations.idiomatic: In year 13 Tanzhou was captured and the secretariat seat was established there at once.

sentences.zh: 十八年，復徙置鄂州，統有三十路、三府。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year it was moved back to Ezhou, governing thirty circuits and three prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In year 18 the seat was moved back to Ezhou, administering thirty circuits and three prefectures.

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Sichuan and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Sichuan and Other Regions

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, its territory was subordinated to Shaanxi.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's early years the region was administered under Shaanxi.

sentences.zh: 至元十八年，以陜西行中書分省四川。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year of Zhiyuan the Shaanxi Branch Secretariat was divided to form a separate province for Sichuan.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 18 (1281) Sichuan was detached as a separate branch from the Shaanxi secretariat.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，始置四川行省，署成都，統有九路、五府。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Sichuan Branch Secretariat was formally established, with its seat at Chengdu, governing nine circuits and five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 the Sichuan branch secretariat was formally established at Chengdu, administering nine circuits and five prefectures.

sentences.zh: 遼陽等處行中書省，至元二十四年置，治遼陽路，統有七路、一府。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Liaoyang and Other Regions, established in the twenty-fourth year of Zhiyuan, with its seat at Liaoyang Circuit, governing seven circuits and one prefecture.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Liaoyang and Other Regions, established in Zhiyuan 24 (1287), seated at Liaoyang and administering seven circuits and one prefecture.

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Gansu and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Gansu and Other Regions

sentences.zh: 中統二年，立行省於中興。

translations.literal: In the second year of Zhongtong a branch secretariat was established at Zhongxing.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 2 (1261) a branch secretariat was established at Zhongxing.

translations.literal: In the tenth year of Zhiyuan it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: It was abolished in Zhiyuan 10 (1273).

sentences.zh: 十八年復立，二十二年復罷，改立宣慰司。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year it was re-established; in the twenty-second year it was again abolished and a Pacification Commission was established in its place.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in year 18, abolished again in year 22, and replaced by a pacification commission.

sentences.zh: 二十三年，徙置中興省於甘州，立甘肅行省。

translations.literal: In the twenty-third year the Zhongxing province was moved to Ganzhou and the Gansu Branch Secretariat was established.
translations.idiomatic: In year 23 the Zhongxing secretariat was moved to Ganzhou and the Gansu branch secretariat was established.

sentences.zh: 三十一年，分省按治寧夏，尋並歸之。

translations.literal: In the thirty-first year a separate province was set up to administer Ningxia; soon it was merged back.
translations.idiomatic: In year 31 a separate secretariat was created to administer Ningxia, but it was soon merged back in.

sentences.zh: 本省治甘州路，統有七路、二州。

translations.literal: This province had its seat at Ganzhou Circuit and governed seven circuits and two subprefectures.
translations.idiomatic: The secretariat was seated at Ganzhou and administered seven circuits and two subprefectures.

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Lingbei and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Lingbei and Other Regions

sentences.zh: 國初，太祖定都於哈剌和林河之西，因名其城曰和林，立元昌路。

translations.literal: At the founding of the state, Taizu fixed his capital west of the Kerulen River and therefore named the city Karakorum; he established Yuanchang Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: In the dynasty's early years Taizu established his capital west of the Kerulen River and named the city Karakorum, creating Yuanchang Circuit.

sentences.zh: 中統元年，世祖遷都中興，始置宣慰司都元帥府。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhongtong Shizu moved the capital to Zhongxing and first established a Pacification Commission and Grand Marshal's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: When Shizu moved the capital to Zhongxing in Zhongtong 1 (1260), a pacification commission and grand marshal's headquarters were first established there.

sentences.zh: 大德十一年，改立和林等處行中書省，右丞相、左丞相各一員。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Dade the Karakorum and Other Regions Branch Secretariat was established, with one Right Chancellor and one Left Chancellor.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 11 (1307) the Karakorum branch secretariat was established, with one right and one left chancellor.

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Zhida the Right Chancellor post was reduced.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhida 4 (1311) the post of right chancellor was eliminated.

sentences.zh: 皇慶元年，改嶺北等處行中書省，設官如上，治和寧路，統有北邊等處。

translations.literal: In the first year of Huangqing it was renamed the Lingbei and Other Regions Branch Secretariat; offices were set up as above; its seat was at Hewing Circuit, governing the northern frontier and other regions.
translations.idiomatic: In Huangqing 1 (1312) it was renamed the Lingbei branch secretariat with the same staff as above, seated at Hewing and governing the northern frontier.

sentences.zh: 雲南等處行中書省，即古南詔之地。

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for Yunnan and Other Regions—the territory of ancient Nanzhao.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for Yunnan and Other Regions, in the territory of the ancient Nanzhao kingdom.

sentences.zh: 初，世祖征取以為郡縣，嘗封建宗王鎮撫其軍民。

translations.literal: At first Shizu conquered it and made it into prefectures and counties; enfeoffed imperial princes were once appointed to pacify its military and civilian population.
translations.idiomatic: After Shizu conquered the region and organized it into prefectures and counties, imperial princes were at times enfeoffed to oversee its military and civilian affairs.

sentences.zh: 至元十一年，始置行省，治中慶路，統有三十七路、五府。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Zhiyuan the branch secretariat was first established, with its seat at Zhongqing Circuit, governing thirty-seven circuits and five prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 11 (1274) the branch secretariat was established at Zhongqing, administering thirty-seven circuits and five prefectures.

translations.literal: Branch Secretariat for the Eastern Campaign and Other Regions.
translations.idiomatic: Branch Secretariat for the Eastern Campaign and Other Regions

sentences.zh: 至元二十年，以征日本國，命高麗王置省，典軍興之務，師還而罷。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year of Zhiyuan, for the campaign against Japan, the King of Goryeo was ordered to establish the secretariat and manage military mobilization; when the army returned it was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 20 (1283), for the campaign against Japan, the king of Goryeo was ordered to establish a secretariat to manage mobilization; it was abolished when the troops returned.

sentences.zh: 大德三年，復立行省，以中國之法治之。

translations.literal: In the third year of Dade the branch secretariat was re-established and governed by Chinese law.
translations.idiomatic: In Dade 3 (1299) the branch secretariat was restored and the region was governed under Chinese administrative law.

sentences.zh: 既而王言其非便，詔罷行省，從其國俗。

translations.literal: Soon after the king said this was inconvenient; an edict abolished the branch secretariat and followed the customs of his country.
translations.idiomatic: The king soon protested that this arrangement was unsuitable, and an edict abolished the secretariat so that local custom might prevail.

sentences.zh: 至治元年復置，以高麗王兼領丞相，得自奏選屬官，治沈陽，統有二府、一司、五道。

translations.literal: In the first year of Zhizhi it was restored; the King of Goryeo concurrently served as Chancellor, could himself memorialize and select subordinate officials, with its seat at Shenyang, governing two prefectures, one commission, and five circuits.
translations.idiomatic: It was restored in Zhizhi 1 (1321): the king of Goryeo served concurrently as chancellor, could memorialize and appoint his own subordinates, was seated at Shenyang, and administered two prefectures, one commission, and five circuits.

sentences.zh: 各省屬官：檢校所，檢校一員，從七品；

translations.literal: Subordinate offices of each province: Inspection Office, one Inspector, junior seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate offices of each branch secretariat: an inspection office with one inspector of junior seventh rank;

translations.literal: two clerks.
translations.idiomatic: and two clerks.

sentences.zh: 照磨所，照磨一員，正八品。

translations.literal: Record-Checking Office, one Record Checker, regular eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: A record-checking office with one record checker of regular eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 架閣庫，管勾一員，正八品。

translations.literal: Archive Repository, one Superintendent, regular eighth rank.
translations.idiomatic: An archive repository with one superintendent of regular eighth rank.

sentences.zh: 理問所，理問二員，正四品；

translations.literal: Judicial Inquiry Office, two Judicial Inquirers, regular fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: A judicial inquiry office with two judicial inquirers of regular fourth rank;

translations.literal: two Vice Judicial Inquirers, junior fifth rank;
translations.idiomatic: two vice judicial inquirers of junior fifth rank;

sentences.zh: 知事一員，提控案牘一員。

translations.literal: one Case Manager and one Archival Controller.
translations.idiomatic: one case manager and one archival controller.

sentences.zh: 都鎮撫司，都鎮撫一員，副都鎮撫一員。

translations.literal: Chief Pacification Office, one Chief Pacifier and one Vice Chief Pacifier.
translations.idiomatic: A chief pacification office with one chief pacifier and one deputy.

sentences.zh: 宣慰司，掌軍民之務，分道以總郡縣，行省有政令則布於下，郡縣有請則為達於省。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissions managed military and civilian affairs, divided circuits to oversee prefectures and counties; when the branch secretariat had government orders they were promulgated below, and when prefectures and counties had petitions they were conveyed to the province.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissions handled military and civilian affairs, each overseeing its circuit of prefectures and counties. They transmitted the branch secretariat's orders downward and carried local petitions upward.

sentences.zh: 有邊陲軍旅之事，則兼都元帥府，其次則止為元帥府。

translations.literal: Where there were frontier military affairs, they also held the concurrent title of Grand Marshal's Headquarters; otherwise they were only Marshal's Headquarters.
translations.idiomatic: On the frontiers they also functioned as grand marshal's headquarters; elsewhere they served only as marshal's headquarters.

sentences.zh: 其在遠服，又有招討、安撫、宣撫等使，品秩員數，各有差等。

translations.literal: In distant territories there were also commissioners for punitive campaigns, pacification, and consolation, whose ranks, grades, and numbers of posts each differed.
translations.idiomatic: In remote regions there were also commissioners for punitive campaigns, pacification, and consolation, differing in rank, grade, and staffing.

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Offices, rank junior second grade.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner offices were ranked at junior second grade.

sentences.zh: 每司宣慰使三員，從二品；

translations.literal: Each office had three Pacification Commissioners, junior second rank;
translations.idiomatic: Each office had three pacification commissioners of junior second rank;

translations.literal: one Vice Commissioner, junior third rank;
translations.idiomatic: one vice commissioner of junior third rank;

translations.literal: one Deputy Commissioner, regular fourth rank;
translations.idiomatic: one deputy commissioner of regular fourth rank;

translations.literal: one Administrator, junior sixth rank;
translations.idiomatic: one administrator of junior sixth rank;

translations.literal: one Secretariat Clerk, junior seventh rank;
translations.idiomatic: one secretariat clerk of junior seventh rank;

sentences.zh: 照磨兼架閣管勾一員，正九品。

translations.literal: one Record Checker concurrently serving as Archive Superintendent, regular ninth rank.
translations.idiomatic: and one record checker who also served as archive superintendent, of regular ninth rank.

translations.literal: There were six circuits in all: Shandong East and West Circuit,
translations.idiomatic: There were six such circuits: Shandong East and West,

translations.literal: (established at Yidu Circuit.)
translations.idiomatic: (established at Yidu Circuit)

translations.literal: Hedong and Shanxi Circuit,
translations.idiomatic: Hedong and Shanxi,

translations.idiomatic: (established at Datong Circuit)

translations.literal: Huaidong Circuit,
translations.idiomatic: Huaidong,

translations.idiomatic: (established at Yangzhou)

translations.idiomatic: Zhedong,

translations.idiomatic: (established at Qingyuan Circuit)

translations.literal: Jinghu North Circuit,
translations.idiomatic: Jinghu North,

translations.idiomatic: (established at Zhongxing Circuit)

translations.literal: Hunan Circuit.
translations.idiomatic: and Hunan.

translations.literal: (established at Tianlin Circuit.)
translations.idiomatic: (established at Tianlin Circuit)

sentences.zh: 宣慰使司都元帥府，秩從二品，使三員，同知二員，副使二員，經歷二員，知事二員，照磨兼架閣管勾一員。

translations.literal: Pacification Commissioner Offices with Grand Marshal's Headquarters, rank junior second grade: three Commissioners, two Vice Commissioners, two Deputy Commissioners, two Administrators, two Case Managers, and one Record Checker concurrently serving as Archive Superintendent.
translations.idiomatic: Pacification commissioner offices with grand marshal's headquarters were also ranked at junior second grade, with three commissioners, two vice commissioners, two deputies, two administrators, two case managers, and one record checker who also served as archive superintendent.

translations.literal: Guangdong Circuit,
translations.idiomatic: Guangdong Circuit,

translations.literal: (established at Guangzhou.)
translations.idiomatic: (established at Guangzhou)

sentences.zh: 大理金齒等處，蒙慶等處。

translations.literal: Dali Gold Teeth and other places, Mengqing and other places.
translations.idiomatic: Dali Gold Teeth and elsewhere; Mengqing and elsewhere.

translations.literal: Of the two headquarters to the right, the established offices were as above.
translations.idiomatic: These two headquarters were staffed as described above.

sentences.zh: 唯蒙慶一府，使二員，同知、副使各一員，經歷、都事亦減一員。

translations.literal: Only the one Mengqing headquarters had two Commissioners; Vice Commissioner and Deputy Commissioner one each; Administrator and Secretariat Clerk were also each reduced by one.
translations.idiomatic: Only at Mengqing were there two commissioners, with one vice commissioner and one deputy commissioner each, and the administrator and secretariat clerk were each reduced by one post.

translations.literal: Guangxi Two Rivers Circuit,
translations.idiomatic: Guangxi Two Rivers,

translations.literal: (established at Jingjiang Circuit.)

translations.literal: Subordinate Prefectures, rank regular fourth grade: one darughachi, one Prefect or Prefectural Intendant, overseeing agricultural encouragement and auru the same as routes;
translations.idiomatic: Subordinate prefectures were ranked at regular fourth grade, each with one darughachi and one prefect or prefectural intendant who, like route officials, oversaw agricultural encouragement and auru affairs;

sentences.zh: 同知一員，判官一員，推官一員，知事一員，提控案牘一員。

translations.literal: one Vice Commissioner, one Judicial Officer, one Review Official, one Case Manager, and one Archival Controller.
translations.idiomatic: one vice commissioner, one judicial officer, one review official, one case manager, and one archival controller.

sentences.zh: 所在有隸諸路及宣慰司、行省者，有直隸省部者，有統州縣者，有不統縣者，其制各有差等。

translations.literal: Some were subordinate to routes or pacification commissioner offices or branch secretariats; some were directly subordinate to the metropolitan departments; some governed prefectures and counties while others did not—regulations differed in each case.
translations.idiomatic: Some answered to routes, pacification commissions, or branch secretariats; others reported directly to the metropolitan departments; some governed prefectures and counties while others did not—their arrangements varied accordingly.

translations.literal: Prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Prefectures.

sentences.zh: 中統五年，並立州縣，未有等差。

translations.literal: In the fifth year of Zhongtong, prefectures and counties were established together; there were as yet no grade distinctions.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhongtong 5 (1264), prefectures and counties were established together, but no rank distinctions had yet been set.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，定一萬五千戶之上者為上州，六千戶之上者為中州，六千戶之下者為下州。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan, those above fifteen thousand households were fixed as upper prefectures, those above six thousand as middle prefectures, and those below six thousand as lower prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 3 (1266), prefectures with more than fifteen thousand households were designated upper prefectures, those above six thousand middle prefectures, and those below six thousand lower prefectures.

sentences.zh: 江南既平，二十年，又定其地五萬戶之上者為上州，三萬戶之上者為中州，不及三萬戶者為下州。

translations.literal: After Jiangnan was pacified, in the twentieth year its territory was again fixed: those above fifty thousand households as upper prefectures, those above thirty thousand as middle prefectures, and those not reaching thirty thousand as lower prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: After the Jiangnan region was pacified, new thresholds were set in year twenty: fifty thousand households for upper prefectures, thirty thousand for middle prefectures, and below thirty thousand for lower prefectures.

sentences.zh: 於是升縣為州者四十有四。

translations.literal: Thereupon forty-four counties were promoted to prefectures.
translations.idiomatic: Forty-four counties were consequently promoted to prefecture status.

sentences.zh: 縣戶雖多，附路府者不改。

translations.literal: Though a county's households might be numerous, those attached to routes or prefectures were not changed.
translations.idiomatic: Counties with large populations that were subordinate to routes or prefectures were not reclassified.

sentences.zh: 上州：達魯花赤、州尹秩從四品，同知秩正六品，判官秩正七品。

translations.literal: Upper prefectures: darughachi and Prefectural Intendant, rank junior fourth grade; Vice Commissioner, rank regular sixth grade; Judicial Officer, rank regular seventh grade.
translations.idiomatic: Upper prefectures: the darughachi and prefectural intendant held junior fourth rank; the vice commissioner regular sixth rank; the judicial officer regular seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 中州：達魯花赤、知州並正五品，同知從六品，判官從七品。

translations.literal: Middle prefectures: darughachi and Prefect, both regular fifth rank; Vice Commissioner, junior sixth rank; Judicial Officer, junior seventh rank.
translations.idiomatic: Middle prefectures: the darughachi and prefect both held regular fifth rank; the vice commissioner junior sixth rank; the judicial officer junior seventh rank.

sentences.zh: 下州：達魯花赤、知州並從五品，同知正七品，判官正八品，兼捕盜之事。

translations.literal: Lower prefectures: darughachi and Prefect, both junior fifth rank; Vice Commissioner, regular seventh rank; Judicial Officer, regular eighth rank, concurrently handling bandit suppression.
translations.idiomatic: Lower prefectures: the darughachi and prefect both held junior fifth rank; the vice commissioner regular seventh rank; the judicial officer regular eighth rank, who also handled bandit suppression.

sentences.zh: 參佐官：上州，知事、提控案牘各一員；

translations.literal: Assistant officials: in upper prefectures, one Case Manager and one Archival Controller each;
translations.idiomatic: Assistant staff: upper prefectures had one case manager and one archival controller;

sentences.zh: 中州，吏目、提控案牘各一員；

translations.literal: in middle prefectures, one Clerk-in-Charge and one Archival Controller each;
translations.idiomatic: middle prefectures had one clerk-in-charge and one archival controller;

translations.literal: in lower prefectures, one or two Clerks-in-Charge.
translations.idiomatic: lower prefectures had one or two clerks-in-charge.

translations.literal: Counties.
translations.idiomatic: Counties.

sentences.zh: 至元三年，合並江北州縣。

translations.literal: In the third year of Zhiyuan, prefectures and counties north of the Yangzi were consolidated.
translations.idiomatic: In Zhiyuan 3 (1266), prefectures and counties in Jiangbei were consolidated.

sentences.zh: 六千戶之上者為上縣，二千戶之上者為中縣，不及二千戶者為下縣。

translations.literal: Those above six thousand households were upper counties, those above two thousand middle counties, and those not reaching two thousand lower counties.
translations.idiomatic: Counties above six thousand households were upper counties, those above two thousand middle counties, and those below two thousand lower counties.

sentences.zh: 二十年，又定江淮以南，三萬戶之上者為上縣，一萬戶之上者為中縣，一萬戶之下者為下縣。

translations.literal: In the twentieth year, south of the Huai and Yangzi was again fixed: those above thirty thousand households as upper counties, those above ten thousand as middle counties, and those below ten thousand as lower counties.
translations.idiomatic: In year twenty, south of the Huai and Yangzi new thresholds applied: thirty thousand households for upper counties, ten thousand for middle counties, and below ten thousand for lower counties.

sentences.zh: 上縣，秩從六品，達魯花赤一員，尹一員，丞一員，簿一員，尉一員，典史二員。

translations.literal: Upper counties, rank junior sixth grade: one darughachi, one Magistrate, one Vice Magistrate, one Registrar, one Constable Captain, and two Archivists.
translations.idiomatic: Upper counties were ranked at junior sixth grade, with one darughachi, one magistrate, one vice magistrate, one registrar, one constable captain, and two archivists.

sentences.zh: 中縣，秩正七品，不置丞，余悉如上縣之制。

translations.literal: Middle counties, rank regular seventh grade: no Vice Magistrate was established; all else followed the upper county system.
translations.idiomatic: Middle counties were ranked at regular seventh grade and had no vice magistrate; all other posts matched those of upper counties.

sentences.zh: 下縣，秩從七品，置官如中縣，民少事簡之地，則以簿兼尉。

translations.literal: Lower counties, rank junior seventh grade: posts were established as in middle counties; where population was sparse and affairs simple, the Registrar concurrently served as Constable Captain.
translations.idiomatic: Lower counties were ranked at junior seventh grade with posts as in middle counties; in sparsely populated places with light caseloads, the registrar doubled as constable captain.

sentences.zh: 後又別置尉，尉主捕盜之事，別有印。

translations.literal: Later a separate Constable Captain was again established; the captain was in charge of bandit suppression and had a separate seal.
translations.idiomatic: Later a separate constable captain was restored to handle bandit suppression under his own seal.

translations.literal: one Archivist.
translations.idiomatic: with one archivist.

sentences.zh: 巡檢司，秩九品，巡檢一員。

translations.literal: Patrolling Inspector Office, rank ninth grade: one Patrolling Inspector.
translations.idiomatic: Patrolling inspector offices of ninth rank had one patrolling inspector.

sentences.zh: 諸軍，唯邊遠之地有之，各統屬縣，其秩如下州，其設官置吏亦如之。

translations.literal: Military Colonies existed only in remote frontier regions; each was subordinate to a county; its rank was as lower prefectures; establishment of offices and clerks was likewise the same.
translations.idiomatic: Military colonies existed only on remote frontiers. Each was subordinate to a county, ranked like a lower prefecture, and staffed with comparable officials.

translations.literal: Barbarian and Yi Chieftain Offices.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain offices of barbarian and Yi peoples.

sentences.zh: 西南夷諸溪洞各置長官司，秩如下州，達魯花赤、長官、副長官，參用其土人為之。

translations.literal: In the various stream-caves of the southwestern Yi, chieftain offices were established in each place, rank as lower prefectures; darughachi, Chieftain, and Vice Chieftain—with native officials appointed jointly to these posts.
translations.idiomatic: Chieftain offices were established in the stream-caves of the southwestern Yi, ranked like lower prefectures, with darughachi, chieftain, and vice chieftain—native officials were appointed to these posts alongside Mongol supervisors.

sentences.zh: 各處脫脫禾孫，掌辨使臣奸偽。

translations.idiomatic: Officials of first through fifth rank wore purple; sixth and seventh ranks wore scarlet; eighth and ninth ranks wore green—and military officers followed the same scheme.

sentences.zh: 其官常對品，惟九品無散官，則但舉其職而已，武官雜職亦如之。

translations.literal: The offices regularly matched rank; only ninth rank had no scatter rank, and then one cited the office alone—military officers and miscellaneous posts were likewise.
